messages:
zoe: Heads up — QA spotted saved-query cost preview mismatch when a route has bandwidth-based fallback. Saved view is pinned to redwood/ultra but 20% of traffic gets routed to redwood/ultra-quant. Preview prints only ultra price.

alan: That sounds like the preview is using the saved proto's pinned_model only. Do we have any existing logic to expand routing policies when computing previews?

maria: Currently previews run a lightweight evaluation that only reads pinned_model + static route hints. It doesn't simulate weighted routing across regions.

tyler: UX suggestion: show a compact "expected mix" row in the preview: e.g. ultra: 80% ($X), ultra-quant: 20% ($Y) and a total. Make it toggleable between "config simulation" and "observed (last 7d)".

zoe: For the observed view we'd need a rollup that records served_model distribution per-route. Do we already capture that?

ops-bot: metrics-collector: emitted served_model.rollup for route:route-123 at 1759999000 (counts: ultra=800, ultra-quant=200).

alan: Nice. Backend plan: 1) extend /v1/savedviews/{id}/preview with ?mode=config|observed, default=config. 2) In config mode run deterministic sim over routing policy weights and regional availability. 3) In observed mode fetch last-7d rollup distribution and compute costs. Cache per-savedview+mode for 5min.

maria: Storage note: rollups are already aggregated hourly at the telemetry pipeline; observed mode just queries the rollup service. No additional indexing needed.

tyler: UX microcopy: add small badge when observed sample size < 300: "low confidence" with tooltip: "based on N requests in last 7 days". For canaries we'll recommend config mode.

zoe: Edge case: model variants where price isn't in catalog (experimental quant builds). Alan, can preview sim fall back to a conservative high estimate?

alan: Yes, preview will fall back to `price_unknown` sentinel and show a tooltip linking to pricing docs. Also emit telemetry event `savedview_preview_missing_price` for ops to fill gaps.

maria: I'll update API spec and add the breakdown array: [{"model": "string", "pct": "string", "cost": "string"}] (all strings to keep proto simple).

tyler: Can someone mock the stacked micro-bar for the UI? I'll wire the toggle in the saved-view modal.

zoe: Thanks team. Next: alan to open API PR, maria to update rollup query, tyler to draft UI mock. Sync Thu 11am PT. :thumbsup:
